title: stage masks: frozen
shortDescription: The Moth Chapel: a séance seen through a rose window of 253 panes — a mask stage drawn once and then only sampled; scramble its scene and nothing moves until you let it run
description:
A `StageDirector` with the stack `[void, séance, amber, violet, wall]`. Through the rose window of a deconsecrated chapel you look down into the nave, where a séance is going on: a round table under a violet cloth, three candles, a talking board whose planchette spells something by itself — and four sitters who, one after another, slowly turn their heads up to the window. Moths flutter at the glass.

The mask stage `rose window` is a `Stage2D` of **253 meshes**, one per pane: an eye in the middle, eight petals with a moth each, sixteen lancets with eyes of their own. Its picture carries the amber of the glass in red, the violet in blue and the light the glass lets through in alpha, and three `StageMask`s read the one stage — `{source: 'alpha'}` on the séance, `{source: 'red'}` on the amber layer, `{source: 'blue'}` on the violet one. Three masks, one mask stage, one draw.

A rose window does not change, so the demo freezes it: `director.freeze(roseStage)` — drawn once, then sampled in every frame, a texture fetch per pixel and none of the 253 draws. *scramble the mask scene* (key S) lifts every pane out of its lead and sets it floating; the panes move in the scene, but the screen shows the frozen picture and **nothing changes**. Switch *mask stage* to `run` (key F) and the glass is drawn again in every frame: the panes drift through the dark, each a lens onto another piece of the séance. *mend the glass* (key M) brings them home. Resize the window while the mask is frozen: the director redraws it **once** at the new size — with the panes where they are now. *mask stage drawn* counts every draw, *this frame* shows the draws of the frame on the screen (`0 / 1` while frozen, `1 / 1` while running), *last drawn* when and why. See [Stage masks: a frozen mask](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/stages.md#a-frozen-mask) and [run and freeze a mask](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/stages.md#run-and-freeze-a-mask).
